verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents an official hosted MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible tools to its databases and Insights. It supports service-token authentication for CI and headless agents, and a probe confirmed the MCP server docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Notion, and other MCP-compatible tools to your PlanetScale databases and Insights
Use a PlanetScale service token to authenticate the hosted MCP server in CI, headless agents, and clients that send a custom HTTP header
Connect an agent to PlanetScale to get help with your databases. The hosted MCP server provides access to database information and tools
official MCP server documented at https://planetscale.com/docs/mcp-server
